descriptionHtml:
Ocypus Lota A40 Black Air Cooler

​The Ocypus Lota A40 is a compact, single-tower air cooler designed for efficiency and aesthetics, featuring a sleek black finish and integrated status monitoring.

​General Specifications

  • ​Cooler Type: Single Tower Air Cooler
  • ​Color: Matte Black
  • ​TDP (Thermal Design Power): Up to 180W
  • ​Socket Compatibility:
    • ​Intel: LGA 1851 / 1700 / 1200 / 115x
    • ​AMD: AM5 / AM4

​Heatsink & Fan Details

  • ​Heat Pipes: 4x 6mm high-performance copper heat pipes with "Direct Touch" technology.
  • ​Fin Material: Aluminum high-density fins with a stealth black coating.
  • ​Fan Model: 1x 120mm PWM High-Static Pressure Fan.
  • ​Fan Speed: 500 ~ 2000 RPM (±10%).
  • ​Airflow: Max 75.81 CFM.
  • ​Static Pressure: Max 2.53 mmAq.
  • ​Noise Level: ≤ 31.6 dB(A) at maximum speed.
  • ​Bearing Type: FDB (Fluid Dynamic Bearing) for increased longevity and quiet operation.

​Smart Features

  • ​Digital Display: Features a top-mounted digital screen that provides real-time monitoring of:
    • ​CPU Temperature
    • ​CPU Utilization
  • ​Warning System: Visual alerts when CPU temperatures reach critical levels.
  • ​Software Control: Requires the proprietary Ocypus software to sync data from the motherboard.

​Physical Dimensions

  • ​Height: ~155 mm (Compatible with most mid-tower cases).
  • ​Width: ~125 mm.
  • ​Depth: ~75 mm (including fan).
  • ​RAM Clearance: Optimized design to provide high clearance for RAM modules in most configurations.

​Key Highlights

  • ​Stealth Aesthetics: Fully blackened components including pipes, fins, and mounting hardware.
  • ​High-End Finish: The top cover hides the heat pipe ends for a clean, premium look.
  • ​Easy Installation: Comes with a simplified mounting kit for both modern Intel and AMD platforms.
